turns.sql:
WITH ceo AS (
  SELECT e.Company_ID, p.People_ID, p.Graduation_College
  FROM employment e
  JOIN people p ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
  WHERE (e.Company_ID, e.Year_working) IN (
    SELECT Company_ID, MAX(Year_working) AS max_year
    FROM employment
    GROUP BY Company_ID
  )
)
SELECT c.Industry, SUM(c.Market_Value_in_Billion) AS total_market_value
FROM company c
JOIN ceo ON c.Company_ID = ceo.Company_ID
WHERE ceo.Graduation_College = 'California'
GROUP BY c.Industry
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
